vendors.name: SAP BusinessObjects BI
vendors.tagline: SAP's long-running enterprise BI suite with universes as its semantic layer.
vendors.verdictNote: Universes (.unx) are a classic governed semantic layer, but BusinessObjects has no first-party NL-to-SQL, synonym or MCP feature, and SAP puts its AI work into Business Data Cloud.

artifacts.name: Universe (.unx) built in Information Design Tool
Universe (.unv) built in Universe Design Tool
SAP Business Data Cloud shared semantic layer and HANA Cloud knowledge graph

metrics.n: The business layer of a universe holds measures that map to SQL expressions on the data foundation.

dimensions.n: The business layer holds dimensions, hierarchies and attributes. Web Intelligence queries pick these objects.

relationships.n: Joins are declared in the data foundation, and the tool can detect or set join cardinality.

synonyms.n: No synonym or AI context object exists for universes. Teams use object descriptions or an outside layer.

verifiedQueries.n: No example query or trusted question store in universes. Teams keep curated Web Intelligence documents instead.

nl2sql.n: No first-party NL-to-SQL in BusinessObjects. SAP's Joule agents are tied to Business Data Cloud.

ontology.n: None in BusinessObjects. SAP's knowledge graph engine sits in HANA Cloud and Business Data Cloud.

mcp.n: No SAP MCP server. CData sells a third-party MCP server for BusinessObjects BI built on its JDBC driver.

governance.n: Universes can be secured with data and business security profiles set in the Information Design Tool.

openStandard.n: No OSI or Ossie export. Universes are .unx files that only SAP tools write.

offers: Single-source .unx universes with dimensions, measures and joins stay supported in BI 2025.
Web Intelligence builds queries on a universe, so business users avoid raw SQL.
Security profiles restrict universe data and objects per user or group.
BI platform REST services list universes and Web Intelligence documents.
BI 4.3 mainstream maintenance ends in 2026, then Customer Specific Maintenance starts.
gaps: No first-party NL-to-SQL, synonyms, verified queries or MCP server for BusinessObjects.
Universe Design Tool and .unv universes are not delivered in BI 2025. Only .unx from Information Design Tool continues.
Multi-source universes are also not delivered in BI 2025, per SAP's statement of direction.
SAP puts its AI and semantic investment into Business Data Cloud, not the BusinessObjects universe.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: BusinessObjects has no native NL-to-SQL. Teams that need an AI agent usually read the warehouse or an outside semantic layer instead of the universe. If the data is in SAP, look at Business Data Cloud and Joule, which are separate products.

vendors.name: IBM Cognos Analytics
vendors.tagline: IBM enterprise BI suite with data modules and an AI Assistant.
vendors.verdictNote: Data modules are a governed model and the AI Assistant answers questions on them, but IBM offers no verified queries and no official MCP server.

artifacts.name: Third-party Cognos MCP server (Activepieces, not IBM)

dimensions.n: Dimensions are modeled as tables or views with column dependency to define grains and hierarchies.

relationships.n: Relationships carry cardinality. 12.1.1 added a relationship expression editor and a Use vs Display value option.

nl2sql.n: The AI Assistant answers natural-language questions and builds visualizations and dashboards from governed data.

mcp.n: No IBM MCP server. A third-party Activepieces server manages data sources and content objects. An IBM Ideas request asks for an official one.

governance.n: IBM lists certified data models, fine-grained access controls and audit trails, and the assistant answers from governed data.

openStandard.n: No open semantic export. Cognos does not appear on the Apache Ossie ecosystem page.

offers: Data modules take relationship expressions and display-value settings (12.1.1, Oct 2025).
The AI Assistant answers natural-language questions from any Cognos view.
Modules can be built from reusable dimension and fact modules, with aliases for role-playing tables.
IBM names 12.1.3 as its latest release, with conversational data interaction and reporting agents.
gaps: No official MCP server. Only a third-party wrapper and an IBM Ideas request.
Teams on 11.2 and 12.0 reported weak Assistant results on large models with similar column names.
Synonyms are set per model, and sharing them across modules was reported as unsupported in 11.2.3.
Reporting agents were Preview in 12.1.1, and their stage in 12.1.3 is not stated by IBM.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Model the data in a data module, define unique item names and synonyms, and use the built-in AI Assistant for end users. For your own agents, the only MCP path is a third-party wrapper, so test it carefully. Check IBM's 12.1.3 notes before you commit.

vendors.name: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy)
vendors.tagline: BI vendor whose Mosaic universal semantic layer feeds agents and MCP clients.
vendors.verdictNote: Mosaic is a GA semantic layer with agents, an MCP server for Mosaic models, and Apache Ossie YAML import and export.

artifacts.name: Mosaic import and export as Apache Ossie YAML
Git version control for Mosaic models (GitHub only)

metrics.n: Mosaic YAML defines fact metrics and derived metrics with aggregation, formulas and formatting.

dimensions.n: Attributes, hierarchies and relationships between attributes define grouping and roll-up.

relationships.n: Hierarchy and relationship definitions are part of the model, and Mosaic models can be linked to each other.

synonyms.n: Agent column descriptions hold aliases and business logic. Auto knowledge assets take glossaries, acronyms and synonyms.

verifiedQueries.n: No verified-query object. Agents use custom instructions with SQL examples and column descriptions instead.

nl2sql.n: Agents answer questions on AI-enabled Mosaic models from the metrics and relationships in the model. GA since Dec 2025.

ontology.n: AI-generated ontologies were announced at Strategy World in Feb 2026 and are not released.

graph.n: No graph query language in Mosaic or agent docs.

vector.n: No vector search over data or metadata in the release notes.

mcp.n: Mosaic models are in the MCP server out of the box from March 2026, replacing a Feb 2026 preview. Models must be certified.

governance.n: Mosaic YAML carries security filters and ACLs, and MCP queries use only published, certified models the user can view.

openStandard.n: Mosaic imports and exports Apache Ossie YAML. Preview in Jun 2026, available out of the box from Jul 2026.

offers: Mosaic serves JDBC, XMLA and DAX for Power BI, REST and Python, with a Tableau connector.
The Mosaic MCP endpoint returns projects, models, semantic definitions and read-only SQL results (Trino dialect).
Models can be exchanged as Apache Ossie YAML and versioned in GitHub.
Agents read column descriptions and custom instructions, with tuning files that can be reused across agents.
Mosaic Studio can import Databricks Unity Catalog and BigQuery descriptions and generate business-friendly names.
gaps: AI-generated ontologies are announced only.
Git support starts with GitHub only and one integration per environment.
Ossie import keeps only ANSI SQL expressions, assumes one-to-many relationships and loses time granularity on round trips.
No verified-query object. Agent tuning versions that test custom instructions are Preview.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Build the model in Mosaic, certify it, turn on AI for it, and let agents answer in Strategy tools. For outside agents, connect Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot to the Mosaic MCP endpoint. Use the Ossie YAML export when you need to move definitions elsewhere.

vendors.name: Qlik (Qlik Sense and Qlik Cloud)
vendors.tagline: Associative analytics platform with logical models, Qlik Answers, and an MCP server.
vendors.verdictNote: Logical models, business logic synonyms, glossary links and Qlik Answers feed AI, and the Qlik MCP server reached GA in Feb 2026.

artifacts.name: Logical model and business logic (vocabulary, synonyms)
Qlik Answers generated field and master item descriptions (semantic understanding)
Discovery Agent and Data Products for Analytics

metrics.n: Master measures are indexed first by Qlik Answers and used by Fast Mode. MCP tools create and update them.

dimensions.n: Master dimensions are used by Fast Mode. The logical model adds groups, hierarchies and calendar periods.

relationships.n: Logical model groups show conceptual association between fields and master items. Qlik Answers reads the Overview and Fields tabs.

synonyms.n: Business logic vocabulary maps alternate terms, and Answers generates field descriptions you can edit. Glossary terms link to master items.

verifiedQueries.n: No verified-query store. Vocabulary custom analyses and example questions are the closest match.

nl2sql.n: Qlik Answers on apps reached GA in Feb 2026. Fast Mode for simple lookups went live in Jun 2026.

ontology.n: None. Business glossary terms and data products exist, but no ontology layer.

vector.n: Knowledge base search exists for documents. No vector search over app data or metadata is documented.

mcp.n: Qlik MCP server GA Feb 2026. Needs the Qlik MCP: Allowed permission, and tools can be enabled per tenant.

governance.n: Qlik Answers respects Section Access, and MCP tools run as the connecting user with a lineage tool.

openStandard.n: Qlik joined the Open Semantic Interchange effort. No Qlik export of the logical model is documented.

offers: Logical model and vocabulary supply synonyms and custom analyses to Insight Advisor.
Qlik Answers generates field and master item descriptions you can review and edit.
The Qlik MCP server lets outside assistants search apps, read fields, apply selections and run ad hoc calculations.
MCP tools cover glossary, data products, lineage, master items and selections.
Section Access limits what Qlik Answers returns.
gaps: No verified-query or example-SQL object.
Each app has a single logical model, so it is not a shared governed model across apps.
No Qlik export of the logical model to Ossie, although Qlik joined the standard.
Discovery Agent and Data Products for Analytics were announced for after Feb 2026, and their current status is not confirmed.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Define master measures and dimensions, set up the logical model and vocabulary, then let Qlik Answers index the app. For your own agents, connect to the Qlik MCP server and enable only the tools you need. Plan for one logical model per app when you think about reuse.

vendors.name: Oracle Analytics Cloud and Server
vendors.tagline: Oracle BI platform with a code-based semantic model, AI Assistant, and an MCP server in Preview.
vendors.verdictNote: The semantic model (Semantic Modeler, SMML JSON, Git) feeds the AI Assistant through indexing, synonyms and AI Descriptions, while the MCP server is still Preview.

artifacts.name: Search Index: AI Assistant indexing, synonyms and AI Descriptions
Analytic Views support in Semantic Modeler

metrics.n: Logical columns carry aggregation rules, and the logical layer holds measures, level-based measures and calculations.

dimensions.n: Logical levels, level-based and parent-child hierarchies and drill paths are part of the model.

relationships.n: The physical layer holds joins and aliases, and logical tables carry joins with mapped table sources.

synonyms.n: Admins set synonyms, indexing and AI Descriptions per column in the Search Index. CSV export allows bulk edits.

verifiedQueries.n: No verified-query object. AI Descriptions add business context per column instead.

nl2sql.n: The AI Assistant reuses indexed datasets and subject areas and answers in natural language.

vector.n: No vector search documented. The AI Assistant uses a metadata and value index.

mcp.n: OAC MCP server is Preview, with tools to search the catalog, describe data and run ANSI or Logical SQL. First listed Nov 2025.

governance.n: MCP tools run with the permissions of the token's user. Sensitive Data indexing limits values to users with column access.

openStandard.n: The model is JSON (SMML) with Git support. No Ossie or OSI export from Semantic Modeler.

offers: The Search Index lets admins choose which attributes the AI Assistant sees, with synonyms, AI Descriptions and metadata-only or value indexing.
Semantic Modeler stores models as JSON (SMML) files with Git integration.
MCP tools search the catalog, find matching data sources for a question, describe columns and run ANSI SQL or Logical SQL.
AI Descriptions state units, formats and aggregation rules for the assistant (Sep 2026).
Semantic Modeler supports Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Oracle databases and Analytic Views.
gaps: The MCP server is Preview, Oracle warns its behavior may change, and a tool (discover_data) is already deprecated.
No verified-query object for the AI Assistant.
Databricks is not in the Semantic Modeler data source table.
No Ossie or OSI converter or open export.
vendors.nl2sqlPath: Build the model in Semantic Modeler, then enable attributes, synonyms and AI Descriptions in the Search Index so the AI Assistant can use them. For outside agents, use the Preview MCP server and keep its permissions narrow. Do not depend on it for production until it is GA.

notes.text: SAP's May 2024 statement of direction says BI 2025 does not deliver Universe Design Tool, .unv universes or multi-source universes, and planned BI 2027 for Q4 2026. Wiiisdom (Feb 2026) says BI 4.3 mainstream maintenance ends in 2026, followed by Customer Specific Maintenance with security fixes in the first 12 months. The status of BI 2027 is not confirmed.

SAP's 2021 addendum tied the end of .unv and Universe Design Tool support to the end of BI 4.3 maintenance, end of 2027. SAP's 2024 direction says .unx universes cover all .unv use cases and that SAP tools support migration to .unx. Wiiisdom says .unv is not supported after BI 4.3.
The list shown comes from the connections named in SAP's Information Design Tool guide. SAP's full list is in its Product Availability Matrix, which needs an SAP login.

IBM's product page calls 12.1.3 the latest release and says reporting agents and conversational data interaction arrive with it. GenAI agents were Preview in 12.1.1 (Oct 2025). IBM docs pages were not readable, so several data module details rely on IBM Community posts.
No IBM MCP server exists. A third-party Activepieces MCP server (updated Sep 2026) exposes data source and content object actions, and an IBM Ideas request from Jun 2026 asks for an official server.

IBM publishes its supported data source list as compatibility reports. The list shown is limited to the SAP BW/4HANA and Microsoft Fabric connectors named in the 12.1.1 release post. IBM also documents a Snowflake data source setup.

MicroStrategy is now Strategy. Mosaic went GA Jun 24, 2025. Mosaic in the MCP server shipped out of the box on Mar 20, 2026, replacing a Feb 2026 preview, and the MCP server itself is enabled once per environment by an admin. From Sep 2026 separate privileges control the Agent and Mosaic MCP servers, and Use Mosaic MCP Server is off by default after an upgrade.

Import and export of Apache Ossie YAML was a Preview in Strategy One June 2026 and is available out of the box from the July 2026 release (release note dated Jul 17, 2026). Limits: only ANSI SQL expressions import, relationships import as one-to-many, and time granularity is lost on a round trip. October 2026 converts unknown database functions to pass-through expressions.

OSI is now Apache Ossie (Incubating). The Ossie ecosystem page describes Strategy's Mosaic import and export, and also lists Qlik and Oracle among participants. No Qlik or Oracle export was found in their docs.

Qlik announced GA of its agentic experience, Qlik Answers and the MCP server in Feb 2026. Discovery Agent and Data Products for Analytics were to follow. Fast Mode for Qlik Answers on structured data went live Jun 7, 2026. Qlik MCP tools now include lineage, glossary, data product and master item tools.

notes.topic: Oracle MCP stage and tool names
notes.text: Oracle's Sep 2026 developer guide still labels the OAC MCP server Preview. It first appeared in the Nov 2025 update. Tool names changed: oracle_analytics-discover_data is deprecated in favor of search_catalog, and ANSI SQL execution was added.

notes.topic: Oracle Analytic Views in Semantic Modeler
notes.text: The Jan 2026 update added Analytic Views to Semantic Modeler, and the supported data source table now lists Oracle Analytic Views as supported in both Semantic Modeler and the Model Administration Tool.

notes.topic: Oracle AI Assistant and AI Descriptions
notes.text: The AI Assistant docs carry no preview label. AI Descriptions for datasets and subject area columns appear in the Sep 2026 What's New. Oracle's docs list Databricks as a remote data source through Data Gateway but not in the Semantic Modeler table.
